kind: Synthetic methods results, not clinical evidence

config.generator: NumPy PCG64 via SeedSequence.spawn; ordered independent scenario streams
config.units: Arbitrary dimensionless changes; not PUTS/YGTSS or patient-derived values

structural.equal_covariance_assumption: The same H and E are specified in both worlds.
structural.unknown_transfer_note: Two observed tic means cannot generally identify g,c,t_g,t_c. Unequal known coefficients are an identifying assumption, not a discovered biological fact.
